steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: This weirdo's way too strong! She's beaten back so many of us already!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: I still don't get what she's saying, but she's no joke!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: I reckon she'd make a fine Great Chief!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Gavial, your friend's really strong.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She sure is a pain in the ass at times like this though.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I think we finally hit a lull. I'm gonna go up there and restrain her...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: You, Reunion! You're back!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: So you were the ones who took the Doctor!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: You won't get away!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, you dumb... She's gonna escape again!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm going after her! Tomimi, you and the Doctor stay put! I'll come back and find you!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Uh, okay!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, there's another fight starting.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Doctor, could you tell me what Gavial is like on the outside?

options: (Tell her about Gavial's life at Rhodes Island.)
(Tell her about Gavial as a doctor.)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Is Gavial having a good life out there, then?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Maybe you don't know Gavial that well?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That's great! ...Um, no, I was just thinking since Gavial came back with you, and she seemed to really like you, and it looks like you get along really well.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But that's okay! Gavial's a really nice person! I think you can definitely get along with her!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That's great! Even if she's a doctor, Gavial's still Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That's good to know. Gavial hasn't changed. What a relief...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So if Gavial decided to leave you one day, how would you feel?

options: I'd be glad she found a new path in life.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mmm. I cried a lot when it happened, too...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: How... How could you be like that?! Gavial's such a good person! How could you care so little if she left?!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: You're incredible... I couldn't do that.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I always hoped Gavial would come back.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Doctor, um, about Gavial...! I-I'm not gonna let you take her from me!

options: And I won't let you take her from me!
So how DID that ceremony back then turn out?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, that one...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, what? You call me a kid, and this is all you've got?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who else is gonna challenge me?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: She beat a lot of fighters more experienced than her...

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Gavial, you rule!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: It's wild to say, but could she be the next Great Chief?
I'll take you on!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, what the hell are you doing here, Zumama?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Weren't you busy building your machines? Every time I went looking for you, you ignored me.

steps.name: Zumama
steps.text: ...I decided to come and see, in the end.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: See what?

steps.name: Zumama
steps.text: See if my fists could beat you or not.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You say that like you wanna get killed dead.

steps.name: Zumama
steps.text: Enough talk. I'm not losing to you today, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, you won't know until you've tried!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They fought from noon until night without settling anything. No winner, no loser.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They went until they'd used all their strength, and afterwards, both of them got dragged off by the others.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That's the story of the first time Gavial joined the ceremony.

options: What kind of person is Zumama?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Zumama was someone from a different tribe, but she was fairly close.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Back when they were young, she and Gavial fought a lot. Gavial was stronger than her, but it wasn't like Zumama never won.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But then Gavial said Zumama just stopped caring about fighting for some reason. She started researching machines instead.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And I remember that day was the last time Zumama and Gavial ever fought.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: After that, Zumama barely even showed her face anywhere. Eventually, her tribe moved away, and I never saw her again.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Not even at that final mess of a ceremony before Gavial left. She never came.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial! You're okay, right?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm fine. Tch. Kay's got a hell of a pair of legs. Just ran off and disappeared out of sight.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But knowing how well she can fend for herself, I'm not worried. Tomimi, did Zumama get here yet?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Who else will challenge me?!
I will.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm? Looks like I came back at just the right time.
